nodes.description: Biallelic truncating SLITRK6 variants (nonsense or frameshift) remove most or all of the protein. Reported alleles include p.Arg181Ter, p.Ser297Ter and p.Gln414Ter in the founding families, p.Trp232CysfsTer10 in a Moroccan family and p.Asp41Ter in a Pakistani family. No missense allele has an established role, so the disease mechanism is taken to be loss of function. SLITRK6's best-characterised molecular activity is as a postsynaptic ligand of the LAR-family receptor phosphatase PTPσ, shown in cultured neurons; whether losing that activity underlies the cochlear and ocular phenotypes has not been tested.
